page.overview:
Who is Big Bungee Piranha?

Big Bungee Piranha is huge Piranha Plant and the castle boss of World 2 in Yoshi's Island DS. It is a Bungee Piranha enlarged by Kamek. Like all Bungee Piranhas, it hangs from the ceiling and lunges down to bite Blue Yoshi, though unlike others it is accompanied by smaller, harmful Bungee Buds, which follow Big Bungee Piranha's lunges or move on their own. To beat him, Yoshi must stand on top of a Chomp Rock, and when Big Bungee Piranha reaches down to devour him, Yoshi must move out of the way quickly, and Big Bungee Piranha will bite down on the Chomp Rock and howl in pain for a few seconds, revealing his weak spot; his tongue. After two hits, Big Bungee Piranha becomes progressively faster. After the third hit, the massive creature will be decimated and fall at Yoshi's feet.

In Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, Big Bungee Piranha is mentioned briefly by Viridi during Palutena's Guidance dialogue for Piranha Plant.
